answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 156506 Country: India Title: Please suggest dua before digging bore-well for construction of house. Question: Please suggest dua before digging bore-well for construction of house. Answer ID: 156506 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 320/317/B=3/1439) Read the following dua: اللهم انى أسألك ماء نافعا طيباً عذباً كثيراً. O Allah ! We ask You fine, beneficial and sweet water in abundance. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
